# HubSpot

> > HubSpot is a leading CRM platform providing marketing, sales, and service software with inbound methodology for businesses worldwide.

HubSpot offers integrated solutions including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and Service Hub, serving industries from manufacturing to education across global markets including EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. Founded by Brian Halligan, the company operates a Solutions Partner Program and supports startups with dedicated programs.

- [WeightWatchers Completely Revamped their Enterprise Sales Process with HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/case-studies/weightwatchers): WeightWatchers modernized B2B sales strategy using HubSpot Sales Hub
- [TransFunnel Grows Retainers by 50% with HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/case-studies/transfunnel-consulting): TransFunnel achieved 200% traffic growth and 25x leads with Marketing Hub
